title: gymnadenia conopsea proles pyrenaica
intro: Gymnadenia conopsea proles pyrenaica, commonly known as the Pyrenean fragrant orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. It is a type of orchid that has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of the Pyrenean fragrant orchid include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and bronchodilatory effects.
